mechanism: Naproxen (NSAID) may reduce the efficacy of acamprosate and increases gastrointestinal irritation risk, while acamprosate has minimal direct pharmacokinetic interaction but compounds GI toxicity concerns.
action: Monitor for gastrointestinal adverse effects; consider alternative analgesia (acetaminophen, topical NSAIDs) or gastroprotection with PPI if NSAID use is necessary in alcohol use disorder patients on acamprosate.
